$comment: Committed regression budget for the minimal Worker in scripts/fixtures/worker-size-entry.ts, bundled with the package root's required nodejs_als flag. Absolute 64 MiB raw and 3 MiB gzip upload limits are enforced separately. Run pnpm worker-size:update after an intentional increase and review the byte delta. excludedModules lists dist modules (or directories, ending in /) the fixture never uses; the gate fails when the bundle contains one.
